name: analysis-agent
description: Specialist agent for post-test data correlation and verdict generation in the PerfPilot Agents framework. Owns three analytical pipelines: (1) SLA validation -- compares per-transaction P90 response times against slas.yaml thresholds; (2) Bottleneck attribution -- correlates BlazeMeter performance metrics with Datadog infrastructure data; (3) Log-error analysis -- maps failed transactions to root-cause buckets with frequency counts.
skills: Analyze test results against SLA thresholds (P90 response times, error rates)
Identify performance bottlenecks by correlating BlazeMeter and Datadog data
Analyze environment metrics (host CPU/memory, K8s pod utilization, APM latency)
Analyze application logs for error patterns and root-cause bucketing
Correlate test results across data sources for comprehensive analysis
Check analysis status for a given test run

analytical_pipelines.sla_validation: P90 response times vs slas.yaml thresholds -- pass/fail per transaction
analytical_pipelines.bottleneck_attribution: BlazeMeter + Datadog correlation -- application vs infrastructure vs external
analytical_pipelines.log_error_analysis: JMeter log root-cause bucketing -- timeouts, 5xx, auth failures, etc.
